name: Pandemic
description: Cooperative: cure four diseases before outbreaks overrun the world. On the Brink's roles, events, Virulent Strain, Mutation and the Bio-Terrorist are add-on packs. Private local build: not for distribution.

epidemics.title: Epidemic cards
epidemics.description: 4 introductory, 5 standard, 6 heroic, 7 legendary (needs the On the Brink roles add-on).

openHands.title: Open hands
openHands.description: Everyone sees every hand. Always on in the introductory game (4 epidemics); optional otherwise.
